verdicts.rationale: The register name is BARNARDO'S (previously DR.BARNARDO'S), and the PPON's only name, 'Barnardos', is the same name without the apostrophe. 15 witnesses and no co-occurrences back this up.

The register name is HONEYWELL CONTROL SYSTEMS LIMITED, and 'Honeywell Building Solutions', the PPON's only name, is that company's UK trading brand. The company-number org also publishes 'Honeywell Building Solutions' beside its register name, across 16 witnesses with no co-occurrences.
The register name is BFS GROUP LIMITED, and the PPON's only name, 'Bidfood', is its trading name. The coh side itself says 'BFS Group (Trading as BidFood)', and there are 10 witnesses.

All five PPON names are the register's CAR HIRE (DAY OF SWANSEA) LIMITED or its 'Days Rental'/'Day's Fleet' trading names. One of them even quotes the number: 'CAR HIRE (DAY OF SWANSEA) LIMITED (00571025) - t/a Day's Fleet & Day's Rental'.

The PPON names 'C. Wynne & Sons Ltd' and 'C. Wynne Construction (4, 9)' are a form variant of the register's C.WYNNE & SONS LIMITED and a construction-style label with lot numbers appended. The corroborating name is an exact register match, with 2 witnesses and no co-occurrences.
The register name is ATKINSRÉALIS UK LIMITED (previously ATKINS LIMITED), and both PPON names are that name; one has lot numbers appended. 71 witnesses and no co-occurrences back this up.
The PPON's only name, 'P Casey Land Reclaimation Ltd', is a misspelling of the register's P. CASEY (LAND RECLAMATION) LIMITED. The coh side publishes the same misspelling, across 10 witnesses.
The PPON names 'HCG Heating Construction Ltd' and 'HCG Heating Contruction Ltd' are punctuation and typo variants of the register's H.C.G.HEATING CONSTRUCTION LIMITED. No other names appear.
The PPON name 'Liberata UK Limited' matches the register's LIBERATA UK LIMITED exactly, and 'Liberate UK Limited - Lot 1' is a typo of it. 6 witnesses and no co-occurrences back this up.

The PPON's only name, 'Frank Rogers Building Contractors Ltd', is a form variant of the register's FRANK ROGERS (BUILDING CONTRACTOR) LIMITED. The coh side publishes the same name, across 16 witnesses.

The PPON's only name, 'M J Group Construction and Roofing Ltd', is a punctuation variant of the register's M & J GROUP (CONSTRUCTION & ROOFING) LTD. The coh side carries the same string, across 21 witnesses.

The register is STARK BUILDING MATERIALS UK LIMITED (previously SAINT-GOBAIN BUILDING DISTRIBUTION LIMITED), and the coh side lists its merchant brands (Jewson, George Boyd, Frazer, 'J P Corry'), some tagged '[legal entity: STARK Building Materials UK Ltd]'. The PPON's only name, 'J P Corry', is one of those brands, with 9 witnesses and no co-occurrences.
The PPON's only name, 'Cell Path Ltd', is a spacing variant of the register's CELLPATH LIMITED. The coh side publishes both forms.

The PPON names 'FCA' and 'Financial Conduct Authority' are the register's THE FINANCIAL CONDUCT AUTHORITY. The coh-side strays (Fujitsu, London Economics, Populus) look like the FCA's own numbers attached to its suppliers and do not touch the PPON side.

The PPON name 'TRUSTMARQUE SOLUTIONS LIMITED' matches the register exactly, across 19 witnesses. 'Claris International' (a software vendor Trustmarque resells) is a single stray, even though it set the PPON's head.

The PPON name 'Hamilton Sales & Services UK Limited' is a form variant of the register's HAMILTON SALES & SERVICE UK LTD. 'AB Sciex UK Limited' is a stray that appears on both sides, which suggests one notice attached Hamilton's identifiers to AB Sciex.
The PPON's only name, 'BDP Ltd (Build Design Partnership Ltd)', is the register's BUILDING DESIGN PARTNERSHIP LIMITED and its BDP acronym. The coh side carries the same name, across 17 witnesses.

The PPON name 'B. BRAUN MEDICAL LIMITED' is the exact register form, and 7 witnesses pair the PPON with 02296559. But the PPON's head, 'B Braun Avitum UK Ltd', is a real separate company (B. BRAUN AVITUM UK LIMITED, 04153656, checked on Companies House). The notice behind the Avitum name, or the CDP record's company number, would settle whether that name is a stray or the owner.
The PPON names 'Dwr Cymru Cyf' and 'Welsh Water/ Dwr Cymru' are the register's DWR CYMRU CYFYNGEDIG (Cyf is the short form) and its English trading name. 17 witnesses back this up.
The PPON names are 'ASHI GROUP LIMITED', an exact register match, and 'Anglian Building Products a Division of ASHI Group Limited'. The register also lists the previous name ANGLIAN WINDOWS LIMITED.

The register is MUFG CORPORATE MARKETS TREASURY LIMITED (previously Link Treasury Services and Capita Treasury Solutions), and the PPON's only name is the brand 'MUFG Corporate Markets (A division of MUFG Pension & Market Services)'. The coh side also publishes that brand. It is medium because the brand is shared with sister MUFG Corporate Markets companies, but 6 witnesses pair it with 02652033.
The PPON's only name is 'Sync', and the coh side says 'Sync (A Trading Name of GBM Digital Technologies Ltd)'. That is the register's GBM DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED.
The PPON names 'CITYAXIS LIMITED' and 'City Axis Limited' match the register's CITYAXIS LIMITED exactly or differ only by spacing.

The register is OCS GROUP UK LIMITED, with no previous name like 'OCS UK&I'. The PPON's only name, 'OCS UK&I Ltd', is the exact name of a separate sister company, OCS UK&I LIMITED (06355228, formerly ATALIAN SERVEST LIMITED until Oct 2023, checked on Companies House). The 21 witnesses pairing it with 03056469 could be a supplier or publisher error, so it is medium; the CDP record's company number for the PPON would settle it.
The PPON names 'Northern Trains Limited' and 'Northern Train Limited' are the register's NORTHERN TRAINS LIMITED and a one-letter variant. 132 witnesses and no co-occurrences back this up.

The PPON's only name, 'Logan Construction SE Ltd (10, 11)', is the register's LOGAN CONSTRUCTION (SOUTH EAST) LTD with SE abbreviated and lot numbers appended. The coh side carries 'Logan Construction (SE) Limited'.
The PPON's only name, 'SPTLabtech', is the register's SPT LABTECH LIMITED. The coh side also shows the previous name TTP LABTECH ('TTPLabtech Ltd').
The PPON names 'Building Research Establishment Limited', '(BRE)' and the transposed 'Building Establishment Research Limited' are all the register's BUILDING RESEARCH ESTABLISHMENT LIMITED.
The PPON's only name, 'AFL Architects (Atherden Fuller Leng Ltd)', gives the register's ATHERDEN FULLER LENG LIMITED with its AFL Architects trading name. The coh side carries the same name.

The PPON name 'Artic Building Services Limited' matches the register's ARTIC BUILDING SERVICES LIMITED exactly, and it is also the PPON's head. 'Archizone Site Services Ltd.' is a single stray, but with only 1 witness and the PPON's names split 1:1, it is medium.
The PPON's only name, 'Cuncliffes Ltd', is a one-letter misspelling of the register's CUNLIFFES LIMITED. The coh side carries both spellings.

The PPON names 'Waste & Resources Action Programme' and 'WRAP (...)' are the register's THE WASTE AND RESOURCES ACTION PROGRAMME, across 19 witnesses. The register status 'Converted / Closed' reflects WRAP's conversion to a charitable form, which keeps the same legal body and so does not make it a different entity.
The PPON's only name, '24x7 Ltd', is a spacing variant of the register's 24 X 7 LTD., across 21 witnesses.
The PPON's only name, 'Social Care Institute of Excellence', is a for/of variant of the register's SOCIAL CARE INSTITUTE FOR EXCELLENCE. The coh side carries the same string, across 7 witnesses.

The PPON's names split three ways: 'The NHS Confederation' (the register name), 'NHS Confederation (Services) Co Ltd' (the head, a subsidiary-style name that suggests a separate company), and 'The NHS Alliance', a different body that is also what corroborated the plan. There is only 1 witness, and the coh side has strays (Diabetes UK). The CDP record's company number for the PPON, or the witness notice's party block, would settle whose PPON it is.

The PPON name 'York St John University' matches the register's YORK ST JOHN UNIVERSITY exactly. 'YSJU Graduation Service ITT' is the university's own project label, which also appears on the coh side.
The PPON names 'Offshore Renewable Energy Catapult' and 'ORE Catapult' are the register's OFFSHORE RENEWABLE ENERGY CATAPULT and its acronym.

25 witnesses pair the PPON with 04806777 under the name 'Classic Builders (South West) Limited (8)', which is the register's CLASSIC BUILDERS (SOUTH WEST) LIMITED with a lot number appended. 'J Group Construction' set the PPON's head and looks like a stray: Companies House shows J GROUP CONSTRUCTION LIMITED (17253850) was only incorporated in June 2026, in Henfield. The notice that named the PPON 'J Group Construction' would confirm it.

The PPON's only name, 'St John Ambulance Cymru', is the operating name of the register's THE PRIORY FOR WALES OF THE MOST VENERABLE ORDER OF THE HOSPITAL OF ST. JOHN OF JERUSALEM. The coh side publishes both names together.

The register is THINK RECRUITMENT (UK) LIMITED (an employment agency, no previous names). The PPON's only name, 'Think Education Partners Ltd', is the exact name of a separate sister company, THINK EDUCATION PARTNERS LIMITED (15118119, renamed from Colmore Services Ltd in May 2025, same Sutton Coldfield site, checked on Companies House). It is medium because there is only 1 witness and Think Recruitment may trade as 'Think Education'; the CDP record's company number for the PPON would settle it.

reviews.rationale: The PPON's only name, 'Barnardos', is the register's BARNARDO'S (previously DR.BARNARDO'S) without the apostrophe, and there are no co-occurrences. The witness party blocks I fetched from the FTS OCDS API (039953-2025, 057650-2025, 058793-2025) all read BARNARDO'S with 00061625 and PHTN-1518-HDWG.

'Honeywell Building Solutions' is the UK trading brand of the register's HONEYWELL CONTROL SYSTEMS LIMITED, and the coh org publishes it beside the register name. The witness blocks (048585-2025, 065660-2025, 065673-2025) read HONEYWELL CONTROL SYSTEMS LIMITED with 00217803 and this PPON, and no other Honeywell entity appears.

'Bidfood' is the trading name of the register's BFS GROUP LIMITED, which the coh side spells out as 'BFS Group (Trading as BidFood)'. Witness blocks from three different buyers read BFS GROUP LIMITED with 00239718 and PGVD-4164-WXBR.

All five PPON names are CAR HIRE (DAY OF SWANSEA) LIMITED or its Days Rental/Day's Fleet trading names, and one of them quotes the number '(00571025)'. The single witness (084165-2026) carries the same t/a name with both identifiers.

'C. Wynne & Sons Ltd' is a form variant of the register's C.WYNNE & SONS LIMITED, and 'C. Wynne Construction (4, 9)' is a lot-numbered label from the same LHC framework (094489-2026); Companies House lists no separate C Wynne Construction company. Both witness blocks read C.WYNNE & SONS LIMITED with 00633976 and the PPON.

Both PPON names are the register's ATKINSRÉALIS UK LIMITED (previously ATKINS LIMITED), one with lot numbers appended, and there are 71 witnesses and no co-occurrences. The witness blocks read ATKINSRÉALIS UK LIMITED with 00688424 and PLLV-1772-YDYN.

'P Casey Land Reclaimation Ltd' is a misspelling of the register's P. CASEY (LAND RECLAMATION) LIMITED, and the coh side publishes the same misspelling. Witness blocks from three buyers read P. CASEY (LAND RECLAMATION) LIMITED with both identifiers.

'HCG Heating Construction Ltd' and the typo 'Contruction' are plain variants of the register's H.C.G.HEATING CONSTRUCTION LIMITED, and no other name appears. The NHS SBS witness (082849-2026) reads H.C.G.HEATING CONSTRUCTION LIMITED with 01144096 and the PPON.

'Liberata UK Limited' matches the register's LIBERATA UK LIMITED exactly, and 'Liberate UK Limited - Lot 1' is a typo of it. Witness blocks (Cumberland x2, CCS) read LIBERATA UK LIMITED with 01238274 and PNZL-2194-VZYZ.

'Frank Rogers Building Contractors Ltd' is a form variant of the register's FRANK ROGERS (BUILDING CONTRACTOR) LIMITED, and the coh side carries the same string. The witness blocks read FRANK ROGERS (BUILDING CONTRACTOR) LIMITED with both identifiers.

'M J Group Construction and Roofing Ltd' is a punctuation variant of the register's M & J GROUP (CONSTRUCTION & ROOFING) LTD, and the coh side carries the same string. Witness blocks from three buyers read M & J GROUP (CONSTRUCTION & ROOFING) LTD with 01371473 and the PPON.

'J P Corry' is one of the merchant brands the coh side lists for STARK BUILDING MATERIALS UK LIMITED (previously SAINT-GOBAIN BUILDING DISTRIBUTION, renamed 1 Mar 2023). The old JP CORRY (NI) LIMITED (R0000390) was renamed Saint-Gobain Omega NI Ltd in Jul 2024 and is dormant, and the witness blocks, one from the NI Housing Executive, read STARK BUILDING MATERIALS UK LIMITED with 01647362 and PCGZ-2339-GGDT.

'Cell Path Ltd' is a spacing variant of the register's CELLPATH LIMITED, and the coh side publishes both forms. The witness blocks (CUH, Somerset x2) read CELLPATH LIMITED with 01831261 and PYTJ-9243-RDRL.

The PPON's names 'FCA' and 'Financial Conduct Authority' are the register's THE FINANCIAL CONDUCT AUTHORITY, and in all three witnesses the FCA is the buyer, publishing 01920623 and PTYH-4442-XPRH. The Fujitsu, London Economics and Populus strays sit on the coh side only (the FCA's number attached to its suppliers) and do not touch the PPON.

The PPON name 'TRUSTMARQUE SOLUTIONS LIMITED' is the exact register form, and witness blocks from three different buyers read TRUSTMARQUE SOLUTIONS LIMITED with 02183240 and PGCD-9498-WYHR. 'Claris International' (a US software vendor Trustmarque resells) is one stray mention that happened to set the head, and the PPON pairs with no other number.

All three witnesses (University of Exeter, UK Biobank, CUH) carry a CDP-style block reading HAMILTON SALES & SERVICE UK LTD with 02188200 and PZXC-1937-DMVH, and the PPON alone also appears as 'Hamilton Sales & Services UK Limited'. 'AB Sciex UK Limited' appears on BOTH sides, including under Hamilton's company number, so it is one publisher's mislabel and not a second owner.

'BDP Ltd (Build Design Partnership Ltd)' is the register's BUILDING DESIGN PARTNERSHIP LIMITED with its BDP acronym, and the coh side carries the same name. The witness blocks read BUILDING DESIGN PARTNERSHIP LIMITED with 02207415 and PJNX-1574-LCMY.

The witness blocks (UHDB x2, UCLH) read B. BRAUN MEDICAL LIMITED with 02296559 and PLML-4925-BDXJ, the PPON pairs with no other number, and its non-witness names include the exact register form. 'B Braun Avitum UK Ltd' is a real sister company (04153656, same Sheffield address, checked on Companies House), but it is a single mention under the group PPON, so I would raise this to high.

'Dwr Cymru Cyf' is the short form of the register's DWR CYMRU CYFYNGEDIG, and 'Welsh Water/ Dwr Cymru' adds its English trading name. The witnesses list DWR CYMRU CYFYNGEDIG as a joint buyer with 02366777 and the PPON.

'ASHI GROUP LIMITED' matches the register exactly (previously ANGLIAN WINDOWS LIMITED), and 'Anglian Building Products a Division of ASHI Group Limited' is its division. The witness blocks read ASHI GROUP LIMITED with 02540020 and PTJW-4159-VPRN.

The witness blocks are treasury-advisory awards from Greenwich, Hounslow and GMCA, and each reads MUFG CORPORATE MARKETS TREASURY LIMITED (previously Link Treasury Services and Capita Treasury Solutions) with 02652033 and PPPQ-2821-MBPH. The brand-only PPON name is shared with sister companies at the same Leeds address, but the PPON pairs only with 02652033, so I would raise this to high.

'Sync' is the trading name of the register's GBM DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED, which the coh side states as 'Sync (A Trading Name of GBM Digital Technologies Ltd)'. The witnesses carry 'GBM Digital Technologies Limited (T/A Sync)' or 'Sync' with 02719704 and the PPON.

The PPON names 'CITYAXIS LIMITED' and 'City Axis Limited' are the register's CITYAXIS LIMITED exactly or with a space added. The LHC witness (094489-2026) reads CITYAXIS LIMITED with 02748683 and PHTT-9248-ZXMG.

The witness blocks the reviewer said would settle this (033530-2025, 069526-2025, 075874-2025, three different buyers) are CDP-style supplier records reading OCS GROUP UK LIMITED, 03056469, PNJD-4733-GTBJ, uk.bd.team@ocs.com, so the PPON is registered to the register's company, and it never pairs with OCS UK&I's own number 06355228. 'OCS UK&I Ltd' is the exact name of a real sister at the same Ipswich address (formerly Atalian Servest, renamed 9 Oct 2023), but it is also the group's UK&I brand, so I read it as buyer-typed and give merge at medium rather than keep.

The PPON names 'Northern Trains Limited' and 'Northern Train Limited' are the register's NORTHERN TRAINS LIMITED and a one-letter variant. 132 witnesses, with Northern Trains as buyer, publish 03076444 and PZCJ-2164-HJQZ, with no co-occurrences.

'Logan Construction SE Ltd (10, 11)' is the register's LOGAN CONSTRUCTION (SOUTH EAST) LTD with SE abbreviated and LHC lot numbers appended. Companies House has no separate '(SE)' company, and the witness reads LOGAN CONSTRUCTION (SOUTH EAST) LTD with 03167858 and the PPON.

'SPTLabtech' is the register's SPT LABTECH LIMITED (previously TTP LABTECH, which the coh side also shows). The witness blocks (UKRI, Birmingham) read SPT LABTECH LIMITED with 03300999 and PMBD-8859-HNHH.

The PPON names 'Building Research Establishment Limited', '(BRE)' and the transposed 'Building Establishment Research Limited' are all the register's BUILDING RESEARCH ESTABLISHMENT LIMITED. The witness (094128-2026) reads BUILDING RESEARCH ESTABLISHMENT LIMITED with 03319324 and the PPON.

'AFL Architects (Atherden Fuller Leng Ltd)' gives the register's ATHERDEN FULLER LENG LIMITED with its trading name, and the coh side carries the same string. The witness (070281-2026) reads ATHERDEN FULLER LENG LIMITED with 03477456 and PWRC-4246-BYHQ.

The PPON's head and one of its names are the register's ARTIC BUILDING SERVICES LIMITED, and the NHS SBS framework witness (082849-2026) reads ARTIC BUILDING SERVICES LIMITED with 03529819 and PGPT-1484-QRMX. 'Archizone Site Services Ltd.' is an unrelated Epping company (16054234, incorporated Oct 2024), a single stray, and the PPON pairs with no other number.

'Cuncliffes Ltd' is a one-letter misspelling of the register's CUNLIFFES LIMITED (previously CUNLIFFE SURVEYORS), and the coh side carries both spellings. The witness blocks (ESPO, Staffordshire) read CUNLIFFES LIMITED with 03870923 and the PPON.

Both PPON names are WRAP / Waste & Resources Action Programme, the register's THE WASTE AND RESOURCES ACTION PROGRAMME, and in all three witnesses WRAP is the buyer, publishing 04125764 with PCTJ-5948-ZJZV. The 'Converted / Closed' status (closed 28 Nov 2022) is WRAP's conversion to a CIO, which continues the same charity, so it does not make the PPON another entity's.
'24x7 Ltd' is a spacing variant of the register's 24 X 7 LTD., across 21 witnesses. The witness blocks (Coventry, Luton, BCP) read 24 X 7 LTD. with 04142000 and PGTV-4978-TPPW.

'Social Care Institute of Excellence' is a for/of variant of the register's SOCIAL CARE INSTITUTE FOR EXCELLENCE, and the coh side carries the same string. The witness blocks (Essex, Brent, Kingston) read SOCIAL CARE INSTITUTE FOR EXCELLENCE with 04289790 and the PPON.

The witness notice's party block, which the reviewer named as the settler, reads THE NHS CONFEDERATION, 04358614, PVZP-9887-JPRL, contracting@nhsconfed.org, vcse=true (032270-2026, 'Annual membership of the NHS Alliance'), and the PPON alone also appears as 'The NHS Confederation'. 'The NHS Alliance' is that notice's subject used as a name on both sides; the real subsidiary THE NHS CONFEDERATION (SERVICES) COMPANY LIMITED (05252407, formerly NHS Employers Ltd) is one mention under the parent's PPON, so medium rather than high.

'York St John University' matches the register exactly, and 'YSJU Graduation Service ITT' is the university's own tender title used as a name, which also appears on the coh side. In all three witnesses the university is the buyer, publishing 04498683 and PGRG-9322-VXQG.

'Offshore Renewable Energy Catapult' and 'ORE Catapult' are the register's OFFSHORE RENEWABLE ENERGY CATAPULT and its acronym. The UKRI witness reads OFFSHORE RENEWABLE ENERGY CATAPULT with 04659351 and the PPON.

25 witnesses pair the PPON with 04806777, and the blocks I read (Plymouth Community Homes, University of Plymouth x2) say CLASSIC BUILDERS (SOUTH WEST) LIMITED; the PPON's other name is the same with lot '(8)' appended. 'J Group Construction' is a stray (J GROUP CONSTRUCTION LIMITED 17253850 was only incorporated 1 Jun 2026 in Henfield), and the PPON pairs with no other number, so I would raise this to high.

'St John Ambulance Cymru' is the operating name of the register's THE PRIORY FOR WALES OF THE MOST VENERABLE ORDER OF THE HOSPITAL OF ST. JOHN OF JERUSALEM, and the coh side publishes both together. The witness (048983-2026) reads the Priory's full register name with 05071073 and PRYH-2665-RBDM.

The only witness (082763-2026, Midland Heart 'Recruitment Services') carries a CDP-style supplier block reading THINK RECRUITMENT (UK) LIMITED, 2 Trinity Place, dom.hall@thinkrecruitment.co.uk, with 05187882 and PMZH-5958-HBBN, so the PPON is registered to the register's company and never pairs with 15118119. 'Think Education Partners Ltd' is a real sister (15118119, renamed from Colmore Services 21 May 2025, 5 Trinity Place), but publishers attach that name to Think Recruitment's company number as well as its PPON, so both orgs share it; that gives merge at medium, with keep not supported.

verdicts.rationale: The register name is LANCASHIRE GAS SERVICES LIMITED, but the PPON's only name is now 'Sencat Ltd'. Companies House shows SENCAT LTD is a separate company (09875717) at the same Walton Summit, Preston office, so the two are probably sister companies, and the plan is corroborated only by the sister's name, 'Sencat Ltd' = 'Sencat Ltd'. Against that, the earlier 1691 fold showed the PPON published as 'Lancashire Gas Services Ltd' too. The PPON's CDP registration (its legal name and company number), or the party blocks of witnesses 066113-2025 and 082849-2026, would settle whether it belongs to Sencat or to Lancashire Gas.

The PPON's only name, 'Sterling Service Northern Ltd', is a plain spelling variant of the register's STERLING SERVICES (NORTHERN) LIMITED. Seven witnesses pair it with this number and there are no co-occurrences.

The PPON's only name, 'Media Works', is a spacing variant of the register's MEDIAWORKS UK LIMITED. The company-number side also publishes 'Mediaworks Creative Search Agency' (its trading style) and 'Mediaworks UK Limited', and two witnesses pair the two identifiers.

'Heyne Tillet Steel Ltd' is a one-letter misspelling of the register's HEYNE TILLETT STEEL LTD, which was previously HEYNE TILLETT STEEL (STRUCTURAL ENGINEERS) LTD. It is the only name on either side.

Companies House shows 07737430 renamed from CORMAC SOLUTIONS LIMITED to CORSERV SOLUTIONS LIMITED on 15 Aug 2023, and the PPON carries that exact current name across 23 witnesses. The head, 'Corserv Contracting Ltd', names a sister (15034849) that the register lists as dormant (SIC 99999), so it is a stray group label rather than the PPON's owner.

The PPON's names, 'Govia Thameslink Railway Limited' and 'Govia Thames Link Railway Limited', match the register's GOVIA THAMESLINK RAILWAY LIMITED. 'Thameslink Southern Great Northern (TSGN)' is that company's operating brand.

'Cell & Gene Therapy Catapult' is the trading name of the register's CELL THERAPY CATAPULT LIMITED, and the company-number side also publishes 'CELL AND GENE THERAPY CATAPULT'. 79 witnesses pair the identifiers with no co-occurrences.

The PPON's names, 'Vivid Resourcing' and 'VIVID RESOURCING DIV GV2 RECRUITMENT GRP', are a division of the register's G2V RECRUITMENT GROUP LIMITED. The company-number side spells this out as 'Vivid Resourcing, a division of G2V Recruitment Group Limited', and 25 witnesses agree.
'SEVERN HEALTHCHARE TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED' is a typo of the register's SEVERN HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED. It is the PPON's only name, and two witnesses agree.
The PPON publishes the register's exact name, ST CHRISTOPHER'S C OF E (PRIMARY) MULTI ACADEMY TRUST. Its other name, 'St Christopher's Multi Academy Trust', is a short form of the same trust.
'Story Catchers' is a spacing variant of the register's STORYCATCHERS LIMITED. It is the only name on either side.

Both orgs publish only 'Forward Institute', which is the operating name of the register's RESPONSIBLE LEADERSHIP FOUNDATION LIMITED (charity and company 09367066). No other name appears on either side.
'Keystone constracts UK Ltd' is a typo of the register's KEYSTONE CONTRACTS UK LTD. It is the only name on either side, across two witnesses.
'Teign Trees & Landscapes SW Ltd' is an abbreviated form of the register's TEIGN TREES AND LANDSCAPES SOUTH WEST LIMITED. The company-number side publishes the full register name as well.

The PPON's only name is 'BD Group', and six witnesses pair it with BD MANAGEMENT SERVICES LTD. Companies House shows that company is owned by LB Barking & Dagenham (formerly through B&D Trading Partnership Ltd), and 'BD Group' is that council group's brand. Some parent-group risk remains if the PPON was registered by the trading partnership instead (10892844).

The PPON publishes 'Care City Innovation C.I.C.', the register's exact name CARE CITY INNOVATION C.I.C., and three witnesses corroborate on it. The head, 'Oteca Ltd', and the company side's 'North East London NHS Foundation Trust' are single strays.
'Cubby Studios Limited' differs from the register's CUBBY STUDIO LIMITED only by a plural. The company-number side publishes both forms.
The PPON's names are 'UK Fusion Energy Ltd' (the register's current UK FUSION ENERGY LTD) and 'UK Industrial Fusion Solutions Ltd' (its previous name). This is a rename covered by 15 witnesses.

'Zurich Municipal' is a trading name of Zurich Insurance Company Ltd, whose UK branch is the register's BR000105, ZURICH INSURANCE COMPANY LTD. The company side publishes 'Zurich Municipal' too, across 41 witnesses.
'A&O Shearman' is the brand of the register's ALLEN OVERY SHEARMAN STERLING LLP, previously ALLEN & OVERY LLP. The company side publishes both names.

The PPON publishes 'GARDINER & THEOBALD LLP', the register's exact name, and its other name, 'Gardiner & Theobold LLP', is a misspelling. The company side's '233600' is a stray, and 21 witnesses agree.

Three of the PPON's five names ('Gibbs Laidler Consulting LLP', 'Gibbs Laidler', 'Gibbslaidler') are the register's GIBBS LAIDLER CONSULTING LLP. The housing-association names ('English Rural Housing Association', 'Newlon Housing Trust') appear on both sides, which fits a procurement consultant entering its own identifiers for its clients. Medium only, because the head is Newlon and the plan was corroborated by one of those client names.
'Pinsent Mason LLP' is a one-letter variant of the register's PINSENT MASONS LLP. The other PPON name, 'Pinsent Masons 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8', is the same firm with lot numbers attached.

The PPON publishes the register's CITY ST GEORGE'S, UNIVERSITY OF LONDON and 'City University', the earlier name of the same chartered body, renamed on the 2024 merger with St George's. 'EXECUTIVE AND ACADEMIC GOVERNANCE REVIEW' is a stray project title.
The PPON publishes the register's exact THE CORPORATION OF TRINITY HOUSE OF DEPTFORD STROND and the common short form 'Trinity House'. The company side publishes the same pair.

'Zoological Society of London' is the register's THE ZOOLOGICAL SOCIETY OF LONDON without the article. 'Institute of Zoology' is ZSL's own research institute, which counts as a department published under the body's identifiers.
Both orgs publish 'The Prince's Trust', which was renamed THE KING'S TRUST (the register's current name) in 2024. This is a rename even though the cached register lists no previous names.
'Poplar HARCA (Housing and Regeneration Community Association)' is the trading short form of the register's POPLAR HOUSING AND REGENERATION COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION LIMITED. Five witnesses agree.

The PPON's head and main name, 'Morrison Facilities Services Limited (trading as Mears FM)', is the register's MORRISON FACILITIES SERVICES LIMITED with its trading name. 'Mears Limited', a separate Mears Group company, appears once as a stray. Medium, since only one witness and two PPON names are available.

'Hulley & Kirkwood Consultant Engineers Ltd' and 'Hulley & Kirkwood' are form variants of the register's HULLEY AND KIRKWOOD CONSULTING ENGINEERS LIMITED. The plan was corroborated on 'Hulley and Kirkwood' = 'Hulley & Kirkwood'.
'Photonics Solutions' is a plural variant of the register's PHOTONIC SOLUTIONS LIMITED. The company side publishes both spellings, across five witnesses.

The register is FIRST WEST OF ENGLAND LIMITED, a bus operator previously FIRST SOMERSET & AVON LIMITED, while the PPON's only name is 'The West of England Combined Authority', a public body. The two orgs co-occur as separate parties in 15 other notices, so they are plainly different entities.

The register is the listed parent RELX PLC, while the PPON's only name, 'Relux UK Limited ( Lexis Nexis)', is RELX (UK) Limited trading as LexisNexis. That subsidiary has its own company number, so this is a parent beside a subsidiary.

'Willliam Birch & Sons Ltd' is a triple-L typo of the register's WILLIAM BIRCH & SONS LIMITED (previously WILLIAM BIRCH AND SONS,LIMITED). It is the PPON's only name and the witness party is named the same.

All nine witnesses pair this PPON with REFINITIV LIMITED (previously REUTERS LIMITED), and the PPON publishes 'Refinitiv Limited'. The head 'LSEG' is the brand Refinitiv now trades under, and the company side describes it as 'a wholly-owned subsidiary of the London Stock Exchange Group, LSEG'. Medium, because 'LSEG' could also be read as the parent plc (05369106).

The PPON's only name is 'REFINITIV Limited', the register's exact name. Its five witnesses with LONDON STOCK EXCHANGE GROUP PLC also name the party 'Refinitiv Limited', so the party is Refinitiv published with its parent's number. Medium, because this makes a second PPON for one company and the pairing with 05369106 should be kept apart.

'Ford Motors UK' is an informal form of Ford's UK legal entity, the register's FORD MOTOR COMPANY LIMITED. It is the PPON's only name, three witnesses pair it with this number, and nothing contradicts it.

Companies House lists TAYLOR & FRANCIS LIMITED (00314578) as a dormant company (SIC 99999). The PPON publishes 'INFORMA UK LIMITED, TRADING AS TAYLOR & FRANCIS GROUP', and that separate legal entity is the trading supplier. The PPON belongs to Informa UK Limited, and the dormant namesake's number was attached by name.

In the same notice 082849-2026, SENCAT LTD appears as a separate supplier with its own number (09875717) and its own PPON (PZCV-1519-JQRT), so the 'Sencat Ltd' names under PCTR are publisher mislabels by a sister company at the same Walton Summit address, not the PPON's owner.

'Sterling Service Northern Ltd' is a form variant of the register's STERLING SERVICES (NORTHERN) LIMITED, and the company-number side publishes the same spelling. The witness blocks from three Merseyside buyers (St Helens, Wirral, Knowsley) all show the register name at the register's Knowsley L34 9HP address, so this is not the similarly named STERLING NORTHERN SERVICES LIMITED (06010642, Chorley).

'Media Works' is a spacing variant of the register's MEDIAWORKS UK LIMITED, and the company-number side publishes 'Media Works', 'Mediaworks UK Limited' and its trading style. Both witnesses (Anchor Hanover) show MEDIAWORKS UK LIMITED, Gateshead, with both identifiers, and there are no co-occurrences.

'Heyne Tillet Steel Ltd' is a one-letter misspelling of the register's HEYNE TILLETT STEEL LTD (previously HEYNE TILLETT STEEL (STRUCTURAL ENGINEERS) LTD), and it is the only name on either side. The witness 035094-2025 shows the register name with both identifiers.

'Cell & Gene Therapy Catapult' is the trading name of the register's CELL THERAPY CATAPULT LIMITED, and the company-number side publishes 'CELL AND GENE THERAPY CATAPULT' too. The witnesses (79 in all) show CELL THERAPY CATAPULT LIMITED as the buyer with both identifiers, and there are no co-occurrences.

'Vivid Resourcing' is a division of the register's G2V RECRUITMENT GROUP LIMITED, which the company-number side spells out as 'Vivid Resourcing, a division of G2V Recruitment Group Limited'. The only VIVID RESOURCING LIMITED on the register (06459262), at G2V's own Old Bailey address, was dissolved in Jan 2024, and the witnesses show G2V with both identifiers.

'SEVERN HEALTHCHARE TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED' is a one-letter typo of the register's SEVERN HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED, and it is the PPON's only name. Both UCLH witnesses show the correctly spelled register name with both identifiers.

The PPON publishes the register's exact name, ST CHRISTOPHER'S C OF E (PRIMARY) MULTI ACADEMY TRUST, plus the short form 'St Christopher's Multi Academy Trust'. The single witness shows the trust as the buyer, Exeter, with both identifiers.
'Story Catchers' is a spacing variant of the register's STORYCATCHERS LIMITED, and it is the only name on either side. Witness 042244-2026 shows STORYCATCHERS LIMITED, Worksop, with both identifiers.

'Forward Institute' is the operating name of the register's RESPONSIBLE LEADERSHIP FOUNDATION LIMITED, and no other name appears on either side. Witness 092736-2026 (Bank of England) shows RESPONSIBLE LEADERSHIP FOUNDATION LIMITED with both identifiers, and a Companies House search finds no separate Forward Institute company.

'Keystone constracts UK Ltd' is a typo of the register's KEYSTONE CONTRACTS UK LTD, and it is the only name on either side. Both Bolton at Home witnesses show the correct register name, Manchester, with both identifiers.

'Teign Trees & Landscapes SW Ltd' abbreviates the register's TEIGN TREES AND LANDSCAPES SOUTH WEST LIMITED, and the company-number side publishes the full name. The witness 040295-2026 shows the register name, Teignmouth, with both identifiers.

The PPON publishes CARE CITY INNOVATION C.I.C., the register's exact name, and the witnesses from two separate buyers (East of England NHS hub, LB Lewisham) all show the CIC, Barking IG11 8FG, with both identifiers. 'Cubby Studios Limited' differs from the register's CUBBY STUDIO LIMITED only by a plural, and the company-number side publishes both forms. Witness 058906-2026 shows the register name, Leeds, with both identifiers.

The PPON's names are the register's current UK FUSION ENERGY LTD and its previous name UK INDUSTRIAL FUSION SOLUTIONS LTD, so this is a plain rename. The witnesses show the previous name as the buyer, Abingdon, with both identifiers.

The witnesses show ZURICH INSURANCE COMPANY LTD at the Whiteley PO15 7JZ branch head office with both identifiers, across 41 notices.

'A&O Shearman' is the brand of the register's ALLEN OVERY SHEARMAN STERLING LLP (previously ALLEN & OVERY LLP), and the company-number side publishes both names. Both UKEF witnesses show the register name with both identifiers.

The PPON publishes GARDINER & THEOBALD LLP, the register's exact name, plus the misspelling 'Gardiner & Theobold LLP'. The company-number side's '233600' is a stray, and the witnesses from three different buyers show the register name with both identifiers.

'Pinsent Mason LLP' is a one-letter variant of the register's PINSENT MASONS LLP, and 'Pinsent Masons 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8' is the same name with lot numbers attached. The witnesses show PINSENT MASONS LLP with both identifiers.

The PPON publishes the register's CITY ST GEORGE'S, UNIVERSITY OF LONDON and 'City University', the earlier name of the same chartered body before the 2024 merger with St George's. 'EXECUTIVE AND ACADEMIC GOVERNANCE REVIEW' is a stray project title, and witness 083301-2026 shows City St George's with both identifiers.

The PPON publishes the register's exact THE CORPORATION OF TRINITY HOUSE OF DEPTFORD STROND and the standard short form 'Trinity House', the same pair as the company-number side. The witnesses show the corporation as the buyer with both identifiers.

'Zoological Society of London' is the register's THE ZOOLOGICAL SOCIETY OF LONDON without the article. 'Institute of Zoology' is ZSL's own research institute, which counts as a department published under the body's identifiers, and witness 093097-2026 shows ZSL with both identifiers.

'Poplar HARCA (Housing and Regeneration Community Association)' is the trading short form of the register's POPLAR HOUSING AND REGENERATION COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION LIMITED, and the company-number side publishes the same form. The witnesses show the register name as the buyer with both identifiers.

The PPON's main name, 'Morrison Facilities Services Limited (trading as Mears FM)', is the register's MORRISON FACILITIES SERVICES LIMITED with its trading name, and witness 082849-2026 shows MFS with both identifiers. 'Mears Limited' (02519234, a separate Mears company) is a single stray, and with one witness this stays medium.

'Hulley & Kirkwood Consultant Engineers Ltd' and 'Hulley & Kirkwood' are form variants of the register's HULLEY AND KIRKWOOD CONSULTING ENGINEERS LIMITED. Witness 083337-2026 shows the register name, Glasgow, with both identifiers.

'Photonics Solutions' is a plural variant of the register's PHOTONIC SOLUTIONS LIMITED, and the company-number side publishes both spellings. The witnesses from UKRI and Birmingham show PHOTONIC SOLUTIONS LIMITED, Currie, with both identifiers.

'City Building Engineering Services Ltd' is the expansion of the register's CBES LIMITED (previously CORRYMILL LIMITED), and the company-number side publishes 'CBES' and the expansion together. The witnesses from three buyers show CBES LIMITED, Glasgow G5, with both identifiers.

The register's FIRST WEST OF ENGLAND LIMITED is a bus operator, while the PPON's only name is 'The West of England Combined Authority'. In witnesses 031030/031042-2026 the publisher gave the supplier the buyer's PPON (WECA appears as buyer with PGWR-9284-XMRY), and in the co-occurring notices 033830/033834-2025 First West carries its own PPON, PZGT-3998-YBXQ.

The witnesses publish 'RELX PLC' only because the registrant entered the parent's number: they cover 'LexisNexis subscription' contracts, with a lexisnexis.co.uk contact, so this is a wrong number on the subsidiary's PPON, as in the settled Taylor & Francis/Informa case.

'Willliam Birch & Sons Ltd' is a triple-L typo of the register's WILLIAM BIRCH & SONS LIMITED (previously WILLIAM BIRCH AND SONS,LIMITED), and it is the PPON's only name. Witness 094489-2026 shows the register name, York, with both identifiers.

The witnesses from three buyers (two AHDB, University of Kent) show REFINITIV LIMITED, Five Canada Square, with 00145516 and PLMT-5991-PNDQ, and the PPON also publishes 'Refinitiv Limited', the register's current name (previously REUTERS LIMITED). The head 'LSEG' fits Refinitiv's data business now trading as LSEG, but the parent plc (05369106) also sells under that brand, so medium.

The witnesses from two separate buyers (Lincolnshire PCC, Government Commercial Agency) show FORD MOTOR COMPANY LIMITED, Laindon SS15 6EE (Dunton), with both identifiers, and nothing contradicts it.

I confirmed on Companies House that TAYLOR & FRANCIS LIMITED (00314578) is filed as dormant (SIC 99999), while INFORMA UK LIMITED (01072954, book and journal publishing) is the active company at the same 5 Howick Place office. The PPON names 'INFORMA UK LIMITED, TRADING AS TAYLOR & FRANCIS GROUP', and the witnesses (tandf.co.uk contact) only show the registrant entering the dormant namesake's number, so the PPON is Informa UK's.

verdicts.rationale: The register names VWS (UK) LTD, formerly VEOLIA WATER SYSTEMS LTD, and the coh side publishes 'VWS (UK) Ltd T/A Veolia Water Technologies'. The PPON's only name, 'Veolia Water Technologies & Solutions', is that Veolia trading brand, with 5 witnesses and 0 co-occurrences; it is not high because the post-SUEZ 'Technologies & Solutions' brand could also cover a separate UK entity.

The PPON's head is 'THE AD CONSTRUCTION GROUP LIMITED', and Companies House lists that as a separate active company, 04405362 (incorporated 2002, probably the parent). Against that, the PPON is also published alone as 'Architectural Decorators Limited' (the register name) and 10 witnesses tie it to 00386730. The PPON's CDP record, or the registered address in a witness notice, saying whether it was registered under 00386730 or 04405362 would settle it.

The register is PA CONSULTING SERVICES LIMITED, formerly PA CONSULTING GROUP LIMITED, and the PPON's only name, 'PA Consulting', is its well-known brand, which also appears among the coh names. There are 14 witnesses and 0 co-occurrences, so the 'generic' gate is not a real doubt here.

The PPON's only name, 'George Jones and Son Limited', is a form variant of the register's GEORGE JONES & SON (CONTRACTORS) LIMITED, with 8 witnesses and 0 co-occurrences. Companies House has no 'George Jones and Son Limited', but it does have a sister, GEORGE JONES & SON (FOOD EQUIPMENT) LIMITED (01197654). The witnesses include construction framework 048409-2025, which points to the Contractors company.
The PPON's name 'F P Hurley' is a plain short form of the register's F.P.HURLEY & SONS LIMITED. The coh side publishes the same variants ('FP Hurley & Sons'), and no other entity is suggested.
The PPON's only name, 'OCLC (UK) LIMITED', is the register's current name exactly. The coh side's 'OCLC' is the same brand.

The PPON's name 'ARRIVA NORTHWEST AND WALES' is the regional operating brand of the register's ARRIVA NORTH WEST LIMITED, and 2 witnesses tie the PPON to this number with 0 co-occurrences. It is not high because the 'and Wales' brand historically also covered the separate Arriva Cymru company.

One of the PPON's two names, 'THE HIRE SERVICE COMPANY TRADING LIMITED', is the register's current name exactly. The other, 'HSS Hire Group Plc', matches the register's previous names HSS HIRE GROUP LIMITED and HSS HIRE SERVICE GROUP PLC. It is medium only because the listed parent HSS Hire Group plc is a separate company and could have lent its name.

The PPON's only name, 'Howden UK Brokers Limited', is a separate active company on Companies House (02831010, incorporated 1993). It is a sister of the register's HOWDEN INSURANCE BROKERS LIMITED (00725875), not one of that company's previous names. The 3 witnesses must therefore carry a wrong number or a wrong PPON.

12 witnesses tie the PPON to WILLMOTT DIXON CONSTRUCTION LIMITED's number, with 0 co-occurrences. The only name published under the PPON alone is a single garbled joint-supplier string that begins with the register's exact name ('Willmott Dixon Construction Limited and Be Living Holdings Limited 2 3 4...'), which is a stray, not a different owner.
The PPON's name 'Child Action North West' is the register's CHILD ACTION NORTHWEST with the space split differently. There is no competing name on either side.

12 witnesses tie the PPON to PEARSON EDUCATION LIMITED's number, and the PPON is published alone as 'Pearson Education Ltd', the register name. Its other name and head, 'PEARSON PLC', is the parent's, which keeps this at medium rather than high.

The PPON's only name, 'RNIB', is the parent charity, which is a Royal Charter body (RC000500) with its own number, while the register is the trading subsidiary RNIB ENTERPRISES LIMITED. There is only 1 witness. The CDP record or the witness notice's address and charity or RC number, showing whether the supplier is the charity or the trading company, would settle it.

One PPON name, 'Jensten Insurance Brokers (London and SE) Ltd', matches the register's current name (the company was formerly BERNS BRETT LIMITED). But the PPON's head, 'Jensten Insurance Brokers Limited', is a separate sister company on Companies House (08284692), and its other two names are bare brand forms. The company number in the PPON's CDP registration would settle which Jensten entity owns it.

The PPON's only name is the register's exact current name, NATIONAL WESTMINSTER BANK PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY. The coh side's 'Natwest Bank plc' is the same bank, so the legal-form gate is not a real difference.
The PPON's name 'Bayer plc' is the plc short form of the register's BAYER PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY. There are 26 witnesses and 0 co-occurrences.
'Olympus KeyMed' is the long-standing trading style of KEYMED (MEDICAL & INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT) LIMITED, Olympus's UK company. The PPON's only name contains the register's distinctive 'Keymed'.

One PPON name says 'Busch (UK) Ltd trading as Vacuum Furnace Engineering', but its head, 'Vacuum Furnace Engineering Ltd', is a separate active company on Companies House (01920664, Halesowen, still filing accounts). So the PPON could belong to either Busch or its subsidiary. The PPON's CDP registered address or number (Halesowen points to VFE), or VFE's latest accounts showing it dormant after a hive-up into Busch, would settle it.

The PPON's only name, 'krow Group Ltd', is a group-style form of the register's KROW AGENCY LTD, and 2 witnesses tie the PPON to this number. A Companies House search for 'Krow Group' finds no such company, so there is no separate parent for the PPON to belong to.

The PPON's only name, 'C Cabs', shares nothing with the register's RED CAB TAXIS LIMITED beyond being a taxi firm, and only 1 witness asserts the pair. The witness notice's supplier address compared with Red Cab Taxis' registered office, or a C Cabs site naming its operating company, would settle whether this is a trading name.

The PPON's only name, 'NEC Software Solutions UK Ltd', is the separately incorporated company formerly called Northgate Public Services (UK) Ltd, which has its own number (00968498). It is a sister of the register's NEC (UK) LTD., not one of NEC (UK) LTD.'s names, so the 10 witnesses carry the wrong company number.
The PPON's name '3M UNITED KINGDOM PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY (01123045)' is the register's previous name and even embeds the company number. The register's current name is 3M UNITED KINGDOM LIMITED.

The PPON is published as 'Fugro GB Limited', the register's exact current name; the coh side's 'Fugro GB Marine Limited' is a previous name. Its head, 'Fugro UK Limited', reads as a loose variant, but with 1 witness and no check of whether a separate Fugro UK company exists, this stays at medium.

The PPON's only name, 'The National Autistic Society (NAS Services Ltd.)', puts the register's charity name beside its trading subsidiary, NAS Services Ltd, which would have its own company number. The brand-then-legal-entity pattern points to the subsidiary, while 2 witnesses carry the charity's number 01205298. The PPON's CDP registered number, and whether NAS Services Ltd is an active company, would settle it.

The only name under the PPON is an NHS contact email ('Christopher.Downs@northumbria-healthcare.nhs.uk'), which is a buyer data-entry error and says nothing about the supplier. That leaves just 1 witness tying the PPON to COSTA LIMITED. Reading the Northumbria notice where the PPON appears alone, to see whether its supplier is Costa, would settle it.

The PPON's name 'Numed Healthcare' is not a name of the register's NUMED HOLDINGS LIMITED (formerly CARDIOLOGIC (U.K.) LIMITED). Companies House has an active NUMED HEALTHCARE LIMITED (15982458, incorporated September 2024), which may or may not be a group sister. Comparing that company's officers and address with Numed Holdings, and checking the PPON's CDP registered number, would settle it.

The PPON's only name, 'ACCENTURE (UK) LTD - FCA', is Accenture (UK) Limited, an unrelated company with its own number. The register shows WALNUT UNLIMITED LTD, a market-research firm now in liquidation, so the 5 witnesses carry a wrong company number.

The PPON's name 'The Barnes Group T/a Bower Fuller & Barnes Construction' starts with the register's exact name, THE BARNES GROUP LIMITED, followed by trading styles. 'Barnes Construction' is also one of the register's previous names (BARNES CONSTRUCTION LIMITED).

'Linton Instruments' is the trading name of the scientific-equipment supplier LINTON & CO. (ENGINEERING) LIMITED, and 1 witness ties the PPON to this number. I did not verify the trading name against the register, so this stays at medium.
The PPON's names 'KONE PLC' and 'kone' are the short form of the register's KONE PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY. The coh side publishes 'KONE plc' too, and there are 4 witnesses.

The PPON's only name, 'R&M Williams (Holdings) Ltd', is a separate active company on Companies House: R & M WILLIAMS (HOLDINGS) LIMITED, 04716632, incorporated 2003. It is the parent of the register's operating company, R & M WILLIAMS LIMITED, and only 1 witness pairs them.
'Thrive' is the operating name of the gardening charity whose registered name is SOCIETY FOR HORTICULTURAL THERAPY. The PPON's only name is that brand, and 2 witnesses tie it to this number.

The PPON's names, 'Specialist Computer Centres PLC' and 'Specialist Computer Centres (SCC) PLC', are the register's current name SPECIALIST COMPUTER CENTRES PLC with and without its brand. The coh side uses the same variants, and there are 16 witnesses.

The PPON's only name, 'ZIGUP PLC', is the listed parent group (formerly Redde Northgate plc), which has its own company number. The register is its subsidiary, NORTHGATE VEHICLE HIRE LIMITED, so this is the parent-beside-subsidiary keep case.

'D S Medical' matches the initials of the register's DATA (SOUTHERN) ENTERPRISES LIMITED and reads as its trading name, and 2 witnesses tie the PPON to this number with 0 co-occurrences. I did not confirm the trading name independently, so this stays at medium.

The PPON's only name, 'MHP Group, trading under Next 15 Group', names MHP, a Next 15 subsidiary with its own company, alongside the register's parent, NEXT 15 GROUP PLC. With only 1 witness, it is unclear whether the PPON belongs to the parent or to MHP. The company number in the PPON's CDP record (MHP's or 01579589) would settle it.
The PPON's name 'Glen Cleaning' is the register's previous name, GLEN CLEANING COMPANY LIMITED; the company is now GLEN GROUP LTD. The coh side publishes both names, and there are 6 witnesses.
The PPON's only name, 'Pelican Engineering Company', is a plain short form of the register's PELICAN ENGINEERING COMPANY (SALES), LIMITED. There are 4 witnesses and 0 co-occurrences.

The witness notice's supplier address, or Seaward naming Calibration House as one of its divisions, would settle it.

A Companies House search finds no active Surridge Sport company, only a dissolved 'TAG Teamwear', so there is no competing owner. 1 witness ties the PPON to this number.

Only the Manchester food-services sister GEORGE JONES & SON (FOOD EQUIPMENT) LIMITED (01197654) keeps this at medium.

The PPON's only name, 'J& Building Contractors Ltd', is the register's J&B BUILDING CONTRACTORS LIMITED with the 'B' dropped. Three witnesses bind them and neither side carries any other name.

Companies House shows a restructure. The old CPC PROJECT SERVICES LLP (OC366907) was renamed CPC PROJECT SERVICES (UK) LLP after its members left and its accounts were cut off at 31 March 2024, and this number (formerly CPC Project Services Holdings Limited) took the name, so the PPON's single lot-suffixed 'CPC Project Services LLP' label reads as the old name for the business that 10 witnesses bind to 15334213. It is medium, not high, because the LLP is still a live entity that files accounts.

The PPON's only name, NP AEROSPACE LIMITED, is its own company (03472480, incorporated 1997) at the same Coventry address as the register's NP AEROSPACE SV LIMITED (incorporated April 2024). These are a parent or sister and a subsidiary with separate numbers, so the PPON is not SV's.

The PPON's only name, 'Eurosafe Solutions Limited', is a separate company (03851892). Companies House lists it as PSC of the register's EUROSAFE COMPLIANCE LIMITED, which was incorporated in April 2024 alongside Eurosafe Contracting and Eurosafe Training and PPE at the same Sheffield address, so this is a parent beside its subsidiary. It is medium because the subsidiary trades (small-company accounts, charges) and 3 witnesses carry its number, so the PPON's CDP registration would settle whose it is.

The PPON's only name is VINCI Construction UK Limited, a separate active company (02295904), while the register's VINCI BUILDING LIMITED is a new 2024 company that took a £60M share allotment in Feb 2025 (a likely hive-down). The 7 witnesses could therefore be either the hived building business or publishers attaching the new number to the old supplier, and the CDP registration (name and company number) for PLTD3933TDPH would settle it.

Companies House shows VINCI FACILITIES LIMITED filing dormant accounts to 31 Dec 2024 and to 31 Dec 2025, so it was not trading when witness 066883-2025 was published. The PPON's names 'VINCI Construction UK t/a VINCI Facilities' and 'Vinci Construction' point to the trading company VINCI CONSTRUCTION UK LIMITED (02295904), and the one exact-name match is a buyer finding the dormant namesake.

The PPON's names ('A & E Elkins Limited', and the witness's 'A&E Elkins Ltd. T/A Elkins Construction Ltd') are A.& E. ELKINS LIMITED, an active company with its own number (00846751) that other notices also publish. The register's ELKINS CONSTRUCTION LIMITED is a separate company incorporated in 2024, so this number was attached to A&E Elkins's trading name.

"TORUS62 Developments LIMITED" is a stray naming the subsidiary, and the number's other PPON partner is the Northern Housing Consortium (a consortium-gated pair), not a rival Torus PPON.

It is medium because Companies House also lists a parent, ASCO GROUP LIMITED (07853258), that the bare brand could just as well mean.

Its other name, "Vigilant Security", is that trading style and matches the register's previous name VIGILANT SECURITY (SCOTLAND) LIMITED.

A separate company, SCOTTISH WATER BUSINESS STREAM LIMITED (SC294924), trades in water supply from the same Lochside Crescent, Edinburgh address. The PPON's names "Scottish Water Business Stream" and "Scottish Water Business Stream Ltd T/A Business Stream" describe SC294924, so the single witness published the wrong sister company's number.

reviews.rationale: The PPON's only published name, and its census head, is "Individual". That is the placeholder for a natural-person or sole-trader supplier and cannot be the register's THE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY FACILITIES COUNCIL, a Royal Charter body; the single witness (057209-2026, 0 cooccurring) most likely put the council's number on an individual supplier. I agree with keep and would go to high, as the 2026-09-30 campaign did, because no reading of the evidence makes "Individual" the council's own PPON; the reviewer's medium is cautious but not wrong.

The PPON's head "Torus62 Limited" is exactly the register's TORUS62 LIMITED, and "Torus62 Limitd" is a typo of it. Seven witnesses with 0 cooccurring tie the PPON to RS007826, and the census holds no other Torus PPON. "TORUS62 Developments LIMITED" (subsidiary 09687200) is one stray among three names. The altid plan confirms the number's other PPON partner is PJXZ4423NDBT, the Northern Housing Consortium's consortium PPON with 54 names, so the second-PPON doubt behind the earlier campaign's medium is gone and high is warranted.

The PPON's only name, "ASCO", is the brand of the register's ASCO UK LIMITED (previously ABERDEEN SERVICE COMPANY (NORTH SEA) LIMITED), and both witnesses (086231-2026, 095115-2026) tie it to SC029934 with 0 cooccurring. The census holds no other ASCO organisation. Medium is right because a bare group brand on two witnesses could also mean an ASCO group holding company. I could not confirm the reviewer's ASCO GROUP LIMITED number (07853258) from local data, but it does not change the verdict.

The PPON's only name, "Optos plc", is the register's current OPTOS PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY with the legal form abbreviated, which is why it failed only the legal-form gate. Five witnesses tie it to SC139953 with 0 cooccurring, and no rival Optos entity appears, so high is warranted.

The PPON's own published name, "VIGILANT PROTECT UK LIMITED (SC212151) - t/a Vigilant Security (previously operated as Croma Vigilant)", spells out the register's current name and quotes this very company number. Its other name, "Vigilant Security", matches the trading style and the register's previous name VIGILANT SECURITY (SCOTLAND) LIMITED. That self-identification makes high safe despite the single witness and 0 cooccurring.

The PPON's names, "Scottish Water Business Stream" and "Scottish Water Business Stream Ltd T/A Business Stream", name the legal entity Scottish Water Business Stream Ltd. That is neither the register's BUSINESS STREAM LTD nor its previous name CAMVO 175 LIMITED. The 452 census (gb-orgs-2026-09-30.jsonl) independently confirms a separate SC294924 "Scottish Water Business Stream Limited", and the earlier campaign's challenger confirmed SC332092 as non-trading (SIC 74990, dormant accounts). The single witness (049021-2025), and the coh-side stray "Scottish Water Business Stream", therefore carry the sister's wrong number, so keep high is right.
